vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.16.0

The skill bundle provides a comprehensive set of instructions for an AI agent to organize an Obsidian vault using a 'Knowledge Graph' (KG) methodology. The logic focuses on categorizing notes into specific types (Concept, Thing, Skill, Relation), managing links, and ensuring data consistency through a multi-step workflow (SKILL.md). While it includes instructions for searching the web and managing local files, these actions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of note organization and lack any indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution.

llm.summary: This is a coherent Obsidian note-organizing skill, but it can automatically make persistent changes across a note vault, including creating, renaming, modifying, and deleting note content or files.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Obsidian KG-style note organization, and the read/search/write behavior is aligned with that purpose, but the capability includes substantial vault restructuring.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions define broad auto-trigger conditions and non-skippable workflows, including relation-building after reading or modifying subject notes, which may exceed a narrow user request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install script, binaries, dependencies, environment variables, credentials, or code files are present; this is an instruction-only skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill searches and reorganizes an Obsidian note library, but the artifacts do not clearly define allowed vault roots, exclusions, backup behavior, or a default dry-run mode outside the separate check command.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly authorizes persistent note creation, modification, renaming/splitting, link removal, and deletion, with changes cascading across related notes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to actively reorganize your Obsidian vault. Prefer running the read-only check flow first, keep backups or version control, restrict access to the intended vault, and require confirmation before deletions, renames, splits, or bulk relationship changes.

evidence.explanation: The skill asks to auto-trigger for broad note-related contexts and makes its workflow mandatory, including relation-building after merely reading a subject note.
evidence.snippet: 路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill ... 每步不可跳过 ... 读到/修改任何主体笔记时，立即触发 R0

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the read-only `kg 检查` flow first, and require explicit confirmation before applying the full organizing workflow.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A user who expects a limited inspection or single-note edit could have the skill apply a broader organizing workflow.

evidence.explanation: The workflow authorizes persistent file and content operations, including rename/split, create, modify, and delete actions, without requiring per-change approval in the main flows.
evidence.snippet: 名不对题→改名或拆分 ... 已有更完整→删；无主体→新建→移入 ... 更改清单：新建/修改/删除的文件清单

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Keep a backup or version-controlled vault, and require the agent to present a proposed change list before any rename, deletion, split, or bulk relationship creation.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may change or remove note content in ways that are hard to undo if the classification or deduplication judgment is wrong.

evidence.explanation: A single note operation is designed to fan out into related-note searches, relationship-note creation, endpoint checks, and link removal across multiple files.
evidence.snippet: 同一操作轮次必须搜关联→至少建一条关系 ... 建关系后 `read_file` A 和 B ... 再从主体笔记删除直链

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit operations to a small set of notes, review the proposed relation graph first, and apply changes incrementally.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: One mistaken classification or relationship decision can propagate across several notes in the vault.

evidence.explanation: The skill may load local vault content into agent context and persist web-derived information into notes for later reuse.
evidence.snippet: `kg "关键词"` ... `search_files` 搜索含该关键词的笔记 ... 搜索不到→搜索网络后新建笔记；`kg 完善` ... 搜索网络补充更新 → 标注信息来源

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Restrict the vault or folders the agent can search, and verify web-sourced additions before saving them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note content may be processed by the agent, and low-quality web information could become part of the persistent knowledge graph.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The main concern is broad, mandatory note-organizing behavior that can create, modify, rename, delete, and cascade changes across related notes.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, privileged tokens, or delegated third-party permissions are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill reads/searches local notes and can import web-derived material, but the artifacts do not show credential use or data exfiltration.
